about: Quotations of a few sentences, with their address and the day they were read, from pages of the Shanghai Shipping Exchange and of the USDA Agricultural Marketing Service, and two fields of the metadata of AgTransport tables, kept so that the texts of data/sources.json (the entries sse and usda-ams) can be compared with them on every machine. Nothing else of those pages is copied here; their text belongs to their publishers. Spacing is normalised: runs of white space are one space.

Weekly port region grain ocean vessel activity (number of vessels)
Weekly number of grain vessels loaded during the week and expected to be loaded within the next 10 days in the Gulf, PNW, and Vancouver, B.C.
